name: Madeira Cake
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put the butter and sugar into a clean pan
Add the grated rind of 1 lemon and with the hand beat it up to a very light cream
Add in the eggs 1 at a time, and beat well after each addition of eggs
When all are in and the batter is very light and creamy, add the flour
Stir it in lightly with the hand
When well mixed, divide the mixture equally into 3 or 4 round tins, papered at the bottoms and sides with buttered white paper
Dust sugar over from a sifter

source.originalInstructions:
1. Put the butter and sugar into a clean pan
2. Add the grated rind of 1 lemon and with the hand beat it up to a very light cream
3. Add in the eggs 1 at a time, and beat well after each addition of eggs
4. When all are in and the batter is very light and creamy, add the flour
5. Stir it in lightly with the hand
6. When well mixed, divide the mixture equally into 3 or 4 round tins, papered at the bottoms and sides with buttered white paper
7. Dust sugar over from a sifter
